## How it was tested

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named per CONTRIBUTING.md → Branches (`feat/…`, `fix/…`, `release/X.Y.Z`, …)
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (a regression test for a bug fix)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
